name: expiry-regression-table
prompt: Expiry behavior has regressed twice this quarter and nothing pins it. Write a regression test file named expiry_regression_test.go (package main) containing a single table-driven test func TestExpiryRegressionTable(t *testing.T) that covers ALL of these cases against a store with a 1-minute TTL and a controllable clock (store.now): (1) fresh session readable immediately; (2) session at exactly ttl is still live; (3) session one second past ttl returns ErrNotFound; (4) expired session is dropped by the read so Len reports one fewer; (5) a session created after an expired one with the same id is readable. Use errors.Is for error checks. The test must pass, and every case must be a table entry, not a separate test function.
